Baking soda is used to make bread rise. When baking soda is heated, it decomposes and carbon dioxide gas is released. Baking soda also decomposes gradually when it is stored. The longer the baking soda is stored, the less carbon dioxide it releases when it is heated. Plan an investigation to show which of two different samples of baking soda has been stored for longer. Your plan should include the use of common laboratory apparatus and the two samples of baking soda. No other chemicals should be used. Your plan should include: the apparatus needed the method to use the measurements to take the variables to control how to use the results to determine which sample has been stored for longer. You may draw a diagram to help you answer the question.
